Priya Shah: FYI MarinerPay renewal in ~45d. Active seat calls down 66% last 30d (420 -> 140). Procurement raised cost concerns and said a new ML lead is running a competitor POC. :thinking:
Samir Chen: Any errors or onboarding issues?
Priya Shah: No errors. CS survey says 'slow on long sequences', they call out latency >512 tokens.
Anika Patel: Can we pull top queries + avg latency? I can run an enablement session if prompts/seq are the problem.
Samir Chen: Ran quick query - /v1/chat avg latency >2x for seqs >512.
Eliot Torres: Recommend Redwood Optimize tuning: quant profile + lower batch window for that route. Also propose a Dedicated trial to demonstrate predictable perf.
Jordan Kim (Sales): We can fast-track a 1-month Dedicated trial for strategic renewals. Will waive setup fee if they agree to a QBR and exec involvement.
Priya Shah: Samir, can infra provision a 1-node Dedicated pool with model-xyz-q4 in staging this week for side-by-side?
CSBot: Provision request created prov-7902 -> assigned to eng-infra. ETA 36-48h.
Anika Patel: I'll book two sessions: power-user enablement and an engineering deep-dive with their ML lead. Priya, can you share Wed/Thu windows?
Eliot Torres: We'll run a short eval harness: 50 synthetic long sequences + their top 20 queries and capture 95p latency and token cost.
Jordan Kim (Sales): Looping legal and account exec for trial contract.
Priya Shah: Action items: Samir confirm node, Anika schedule enablement, Jordan handle contract. I'll update after the first call. :thumbsup:
